name: CSO_CONTENT_HISTORY
description: This table contains the version history of a content record. The number of records in the history is determined by settings in the Content Channel setup.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content table record.

columns.name: CONTENT_TEXT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content text table record.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified.

columns.name: DESC_LOOKUP_CODE_ID
columns.description: This is the type of comment or user action that caused the history record to be recorded, i.e. APPROVED, REJECTED. Reference to LOOKUP_CODE table.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: USER_INFORMATION_ID
columns.description: The obsolete GUID of the user associated with this history record.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: This is the user provided comment about the change recorded.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: De-normalized username associated with the user login.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_NAME
columns.description: De-normalized reference key name of the workflow associated with the change.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_STEP_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to workflow step that caused the change.

columns.name: METADATA
columns.description: This is additional information provided by the client to add context to this history item.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_STEP_NAME
columns.description: De-normalized reference key name of workflow step that caused the change.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_WORKFLOW_STEP_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the previous workflow step.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The ID of the user associated with this history record.

columns.name: TASK_ASSIGNEE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the id of the user who is assigned to this workflow task.

columns.name: TASK_OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the id of the user who is the owner of this workflow task.

columns.name: ANSWER_ID
columns.description: This is the answerid for the referenced article.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: This is the unique id for workflow instance.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_TASK_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: This is the unique id for external task reference associated with this history item.
